title: Roadbook saved snapshot
description: A saved snapshot of a top-level run: the core's snapshot (spec/execution.md#snapshot) with the format version and each timer's due time, and, in version 4, the saved snapshot of each child run that was running, nested in its invoke or spawned entry (child). See spec/execution.md#saving-and-restoring for what each member means and how a runtime restores one. It holds real values, those of sensitive parameters and variables too: nothing in it is redacted (spec/trace.md#redaction). Every member is required but calls, scheduled, locals, history, historyLocals and spawned, and no other member is allowed. Version 1, written before history states, has neither history nor spawned; version 2 has history; version 3 has both; version 4 has both and may have child members. calls, scheduled, locals and historyLocals, each written only when not empty, may be in any version.

snapshotVersion.description: The version of this format: 4, or 3 for a snapshot written before child runs were saved, 2 for one written before keyed spawn, or 1 for one written before history states.

machine.description: The machine's name, a key of the IR's machines.

run.description: The id the run had when it was saved. A restored run gets a new id.

ir.description: The machine's hash in the IR it ran with.

active.description: The active states' ids, in document order. Empty once the run is done, failed or cancelled.

input.description: The machine's arguments, keyed by parameter name.

vars.description: Every variable that has a value, keyed by name. A variable with no value has no member.

locals.description: The parameters and variables of the active states that declare any, keyed by state id, then by name: those that have a value. Written only when not empty; a snapshot without it has none.

invokes.description: The invokes running when the run was saved, in the order they were started, each with its child run's snapshot if it is one.

src.description: The task or machine, or for a call the address and the call's name (inventory.reserve).

as.description: The as of the invoke it runs. Present exactly when its state has several invokes.

calls.description: The calls the run has taken and not answered, in the order it took them. Written only when not empty; a snapshot without it has none. A snapshot with pending calls cannot be restored (reason calls).

spawned.description: The spawned children running when the run was saved, in the order they were started, each with its child run's snapshot if it is one.

children.description: The collection, one of the machine's children.

key.description: The child's key: a string (a string or an enum variant) or an integer.

args.description: The arguments it was spawned with.

timers.description: The after timers running when the run was saved, in the order they were started.

index.description: The position in the state's transitions of the first transition of the timer's after block.

due.description: When the timer expires, on the driver's clock, in integer milliseconds: since the Unix epoch in production, virtual time in conformance.

scheduled.description: The pending delayed raises (raise E after d as n), in the order they were started. Written only when not empty; a snapshot without it has none.

id.description: The raise's timer id, from the sequence after timers take theirs from.

name.description: The raise's as name, or null.

value.description: The event to raise, a tagged record of one of the machine's events or internal events.

due.description: When it expires, on the driver's clock, in integer milliseconds.

history.description: What each history state recorded, keyed by its id: state ids, in document order. A history state that has recorded nothing has no member.

historyLocals.description: The locals each history state recorded with its states, keyed by the history state's id, then by the id of a state it re-enters, then by name. A history state whose record holds no state with locals has no member. Written only when not empty.

result.description: null while running and when cancelled; the output, the error or the defect once the run has ended.

output.description: The output, null for a machine that returns nothing.

child.description: The saved snapshot of this entry's child run, as its last step left it, when the entry's work was a child run that had claimed its invoke and was running: a saved snapshot of version 4 itself, nested to any depth. Written only in version 4 and only for such a child; an entry without it starts its work again on restore.

args.description: Values keyed by parameter or variable name, in their JSON form.
